discrepancies.incident: Incident tokens inside a later box are extra copies, not a replacement for the 7 that start in the supply.
discrepancies.passport: The book counts 4 passports. The mod stores three allegiance pages (Allied, Neutral, Soviet) for each of the four pawn colors, and each page has 11 cover-scratch states.
discrepancies.player-card: The 58 player cards are the 48 city cards, 5 events, and 5 escalation cards (the save stores one escalation object and clones it). Further player cards are sealed in box 0008.
discrepancies.legacy-deck: The book counts one legacy deck supplied in two parts. The save also keeps the 16 legacy cards from box 0005 in their own deck.
discrepancies.dossier: The book counts 3 dossier folios. Each sealed door on those folios is its own record, because opening one door yields its own components.

notes.legacy-card: The book does not print how many legacy cards there are. This is every legacy card in part 1, part 2, and the deck sealed in box 0005.
notes.debrief-page: The book numbers debrief entries 100–252 (153 entries). This count is that run plus the index sheet.
notes.passport: The book counts 4 passports. The mod stores three allegiance pages (Allied, Neutral, Soviet) for each of the four pawn colors, and each page has 11 cover-scratch states.

notes.sticker-sheet: The three sheets are portraits, allied upgrades (cover occupations, game-end upgrades, surveillance), and liabilities. Stickers the mod clipped off those sheets are mod-extra records.
notes.operations-card: The component list says 42 operations cards. The same chapter says they are numbered 50–89. Both figures are kept: the count is 42, and the numbers are on the cards.
